newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian firm Nile Match has new board.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian firm Nile Match has new board.

text.p: Shareholders of Nile Match and Prefabricated Houses, meeting on Saturday for the first time since the state privatised most of the company, re-elected Farouk Aboul-Fadl as chairman of the board, company officials said on Sunday.

The state's Holding Company for Chemical Industries, which previously owned all the equity, retains two seats on the new seven-member board, they said. They are Hussein Mohamed Eid and Essameddin Muharram.

Other members of the news board are Somayya Mohamed Mazen for Misr Insurance, Atiyah Abdelmageed el-Murshidy for the SAIB mutual fund, Ahmed Mohamed Abdelwahhab for the Banque Misr mutual fund, and private shareholder Hussein Abbas Youssef.
The state sold about 65 percent of Nile Match to the private sector in August as part of its privatisation programme.
